scientific_integrity: Infinite claim supported by a complete written mathematical argument; finite computations corroborate rather than replace that argument.
scientific_limitations: Identification is relative to directed Young-diagram cell-poset cover graphs, not arbitrary digraphs.
Northwest-closed unskewed diagrams and separately counted directed in/out arcs are essential.
No optimal round bound, skew-shape theorem, or independently certified publication priority is asserted.
title: Directed Young-diagram cover graphs are counting-refinement rigid up to conjugation
